profile.summary: Transform (also written TransformCA) is an Oakland-based nonprofit that works on sustainable transportation and affordable housing in California. It runs programs, builds coalitions and advocates for policy change. Its programs include Safe Routes to Schools, which helps students walk, bike and use transit to get to school.
